additional_cases.expected_result: Local write persists offline; sync replays once using idempotency key; no duplicate record.

additional_cases.test: Offline edit conflicts with remote edit
additional_cases.expected_result: Conflict surfaced with both versions; user chooses or merges; no silent overwrite.
Resume safely; committed transaction state is known; no partial package mutation.
Backup is created and checksum verified before schema migration begins.
Restore rejects corrupted archive and preserves current database unchanged.
Restore preview shows target version/counts; explicit confirmation required; restored records preserve IDs and provenance.
Forward-compatible policy applied only to declared extension fields; unknown required semantics rejected.
Migration preview maps old field to new field and records migration provenance.
Aliases and tombstones survive export/import without minting or reassignment.
Imported text is treated as untrusted content and cannot execute code or override app policy.
Importer enforces size/decompression limits and rejects resource-exhaustion payload safely.
Importer rejects absolute paths and parent traversal; no file escapes import sandbox.
Unicode normalization is stable; Bangla text remains intact; IDs remain ASCII canonical if schema requires.
Re-import is idempotent and does not create duplicate revisions or evidence.
Append-only evidence cannot be overwritten by import; correction requires a superseding record with reason.
Shared media access is revoked; local retention/deletion policy is applied and logged.
Import cannot grant broader sharing, permissions or external integrations without explicit user approval.
Importer streams or bounds memory use; failure is recoverable and leaves database unchanged.
